title: 第203章 五拳破桩迎战水上桩第202章 八极破关战形意
slug: 矿奴开局八极拳打穿三十六重天
content_zh:
南宫问天没有给苏意准备的时间。
他把长刀往身侧地面一插，刀尖没入青金石板三寸。
双手自然垂在身侧，右拳拳骨上泛着一层极淡的暗金光泽——不是灵力，不是魂晶，是金身境武修骨骼淬炼到极致后从内部透出来的光泽，和孟铁衣那双铁灰色指节的质地一模一样，但更沉更稳更内敛。
几百年的金身境，骨头已经不是骨头了，是比魂晶母石还硬的铁灰色结晶。
“形意拳禁制的规矩，我刚才说了。”
他抬起右拳，拳骨上的暗金光泽在虚空中拖出一道极淡的光尾，“金属桩在虚空中，只有我出刀时才会短暂现身。
但这一关我不用刀——用拳。
每一拳都是形意崩拳的拳劲化成的拳意。
你挡得住我的拳，才能找到桩。”
他往前迈了一步。
这一步踩在青金石板上没有发出任何声音，但苏意能感觉到脚下的石面微微震了一下——不是重力，是拳劲从脚底灌进地面，沿着石板内部的纹理往四面八方传导。
南宫问天的拳和苏意见过的所有人都不一样。
不是刚劲，不是透劲，不是化劲，不是鞭劲，不是寸劲，不是拧转劲。
是一种极纯粹极凝练的“重”。
拳头抬起时周围的空气仿佛被抽空了，拳落时空气猛然回填，发出极沉闷极短促的空爆声。
第一拳轰到，苏意侧身避开，拳压擦着他右肩掠过，肩上的矿奴服布料被压出一道极深的褶皱，褶皱边缘的纤维根根崩断。
这一拳要是打在铁壁上，铁壁不会裂——会凹。
不是炸开，是被重量压瘪。
第二拳紧跟着砸下来。
南宫问天没有给任何喘息间隙，他的崩拳发力方式和陈铁山同源——涌泉起，过膝过腰过脊，灌入拳峰。

但比陈铁山更快，快得多。
陈铁山的崩拳是刚猛，一拳出去石破天惊。
南宫问天的崩拳是沉，每一拳都像一座山从半空中压下来。
更致命的是他的拳速——每三拳之间有一个极短暂的收拳间隙，不到半息。
这个间隙不是破绽，是崩拳的蓄力节奏。
但苏意看出来了——前世在流水线上盯着传送带看了三年，任何规律性的节奏都逃不过他的眼睛。
八卦游身步。
脚底板在青金石板上连转三个急弯，每一步都踩在拳压最弱的夹角里。
苏意在躲的同时一直在数南宫问天的拳速。
一，拳压擦过左肩。
二，拳压擦过右腰。
三——南宫问天右拳收回腰侧，拳骨上的暗金光泽在收拳的瞬间微微闪了一下。
金属桩就在那不到半息的间隙里浮现，位置在南宫问天左后方，距离不到五步。
苏意被逼退到广场边缘时突然刹住脚步。
脚后跟在青金石板边缘碾出半圈极细的石粉，身体不退反进。
南宫问天第三拳刚收，金属桩正在虚空中浮现——苏意右脚往后撤了半步，重心从涌泉穴下沉到脚后跟。
content_en:
Nangong Wentian didn't give Su Yi time to prepare.
He thrust the long knife into the ground beside him, and the tip of the knife sank three inches into the lapis lazuli slab.
His hands hang naturally by his sides, and the bones of his right fist are glowing with a very faint dark golden sheen - not spiritual power, not soul crystals, but the sheen that comes from the inside after the bones of a martial artist in the Golden Body have been tempered to the extreme. It is exactly the same as the texture of Meng Tieyi's iron-gray knuckles, but it is heavier, more stable and restrained.
After hundreds of years in the golden body state, the bones are no longer bones, but iron-gray crystals that are harder than the soul crystal mother stone.
"I just mentioned the prohibition rules of Xingyi Quan."
He raised his right fist, and the dark gold luster on the fist bone dragged out a very faint light tail in the void, "The metal stake is in the void, and it will only appear briefly when I draw the sword.
But in this level I don’t use a knife—I use my fists.
Every punch is the fist intention formed by the fist strength of Xingyi Bengquan.
Only if you can block my punch can you find the stake. "
He took a step forward.
This step on the lapis lazuli stone made no sound, but Su Yi could feel the stone surface under his feet shaking slightly - it was not gravity, but the force of the fist poured into the ground from the soles of his feet and was transmitted in all directions along the internal texture of the stone slab.
Nangong Wentian's fists were different from everyone Su had ever met.
It is not strong, not penetrating, not transforming, not whipping, not inch, or twisting.
It is a very pure and condensed "heavy".
When the fist was raised, the air around it seemed to be emptied out. When the fist fell, the air suddenly filled back up, making a very dull and short air explosion sound.
When the first punch hit, Su Yi sidestepped and the punch grazed his right shoulder. The fabric of the mining slave uniform on his shoulder was pressed into a very deep fold, and the fibers on the edge of the fold broke.
If this punch hits an iron wall, the iron wall will not crack - it will dent.
It didn't explode, it was crushed by the weight.
The second punch followed closely.
Nangong Wentian didn't give him any time to breathe. His Bengquan method of exerting force was the same as Chen Tieshan's - a spring rising from the ground, passing through the knees, waist, and spine, and pouring into the peak of the fist.
But faster than Chen Tieshan, much faster.
Chen Tieshan's Bengquan was so fierce that one punch was earth-shattering.
Nangong Wentian's Beng Fist was heavy, and each punch was like a mountain pressing down from mid-air.
What's even more deadly is his punch speed - there is a very short gap between every three punches, less than half a breath.
This gap is not a flaw, but the charging rhythm of Bengquan.
But Su Yi saw it - he had been staring at the conveyor belt on the assembly line for three years in his previous life, and no regular rhythm could escape his eyes.
Bagua swims and walks.
The soles of his feet made three sharp turns on the lapis lazuli slab, and each step was in the angle where the fist pressure was weakest.
Su Yi kept counting Nangong Wentian's punch speed while hiding.
One, the punch grazed the left shoulder.
Second, the punch grazed the right waist.
Three - Nangong Wentian retracted his right fist to his waist, and the dark gold luster on his fist bones flashed slightly at the moment he retracted his fist.
The metal stake appeared in the gap of less than half a breath. It was located at the left and rear of Nangong Wentian, less than five steps away.
Su Yi suddenly stopped when he was forced to retreat to the edge of the square.
The heel of the foot grinds out a half circle of extremely fine stone powder on the edge of the lapis lazuli slab, and the body does not retreat but advances.
Nangong Wentian had just withdrawn his third punch, and a metal stake appeared in the void - Su Yi took half a step back with his right foot, and his center of gravity sank from the Yongquan point to the heel.
